_doc: Generated-only replacement placement spec. Heading anchors were retained from the original reviewed placement file.

figures.alt: Straight metal drywall corner bead prepared for thin finish coats
figures.caption: Remove loose compound and identify whether the bead is dented, detached, or hiding movement in the framing behind the corner.
figures.before: When You Need a Permit in Jacksonville

figures.alt: Open interior wall cavity showing clean framing and a utility route
figures.caption: If a corner crack keeps returning, check for movement or a framing issue before covering it with more compound. A smooth surface cannot correct a moving substrate.

figures.alt: Finished interior door opening with trim set against a smooth wall plane
figures.caption: Let each thin coat dry fully, sand gently, and prime before paint. The final wall plane should meet nearby trim without a raised repair ridge.
